notes.title: Flipside v0.3.2
notes.notes:
Hello Flipsiders,

I just pushed up the first of many updates for Flipside Genesis. It's a pretty minor one with a few bug fixes and updates, including:

- Preliminary work towards a refactor of ship subsystems, which will allow system specific damage, upgrading systems, etc.
- General bug fixes, including an issue closing the missions menu and some bad collision geo in the hangar (thanks @pebblegarden).

As always, let me know your thoughts!

Cheers,

GrimFoxJones

notes.title: Flipside Genesis launched today!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

[strike]RoboGenesis [/strike] Flipside Genesis launched on Early Access today!

I should have posted this earlier, as it will probably affect a good number of you who were interested in the original game, RoboGenesis. The game is now called "Flipside Genesis" and is pretty much a completely different experience. I took over solo development of the project a few months ago and the original concept was just too much for a single developer.

If the new game looks interesting (it's a single player space shooter), check it out! If not, I apologise for not updating you sooner.

It is early access in the truest definition... many of the planned features aren't in place and the current experience is a bit shallow. I really look forward to working with the players as the game is developed, and I think you will be pleased at how quickly progress is made!

At any rate, thanks for checking out Flipside Genesis and I look forward to hearing your thoughts over the coming months!

Cheers,

GrimFoxJones
